description: Read the official Uwear QA check of existing generation results. Call this first when the user asks to QA/check/validate/review generated outputs: most image results already have a free AI check. ai_qa gives the state (checking, passed, issues, unavailable, not_checked, not_supported) and ai_qa_json its structured details; qa_status/qa_decision are the approve/reject QA only. The AI check is an opinion, separate from the result's review decision. Summarize the structured check and issues, not a manual view_image opinion. Queue QA only when needed.

inputSchema.description: Input schema for reading QA rows for generation results.

generation_result_ids.description: Generation result IDs to read QA for
